title.ko: 자료 분석: correlate with · account for · a marked disparity · the vast majority
title.en: analysing data in depth: correlate with, account for, a marked disparity, the vast majority

explain.ko: 자료를 깊이 있게 분석할 때는 단순한 수치 나열을 넘어 관계, 비율, 차이, 해석을 구분해 설명합니다. 비율은 account for, make up, represent로, 관계는 correlate with, be associated with, be proportional to로, 차이는 disparity, gap, marked difference로 표현합니다. 상관관계가 인과 관계를 의미하지 않는다는 점, 이상치(outlier)와 표본 크기를 고려해야 한다는 점을 함께 언급하면 분석의 신뢰도가 높아집니다.
explain.en: Deep analysis goes beyond listing numbers to explain relationships, proportions, differences and interpretation. Proportions use account for, make up or represent; relationships use correlate with, be associated with or be proportional to; differences use disparity, gap or marked difference. Mentioning that correlation does not imply causation, and considering outliers and sample size, increases credibility.

notes.ko: 수치를 말할 때는 출처와 표본 크기를 함께 밝히세요.
notes.en: Cite source and sample size with figures.
Treat outliers separately and explain why.

task.model: Public transport users account for seventy per cent of respondents. A correlation emerged between higher income and greater car use. Differences between age groups were not pronounced. However, the sample is small, so the results must be interpreted with caution.

model_trans.en: Public transport users account for seventy per cent of respondents. A correlation emerged between higher income and greater car use. Differences between age groups were not pronounced. However, the sample is small, so the results must be interpreted with caution.
